# SPORTENVO Third-Party Citation & Media Outreach

Version: 2026-09-29

Purpose: build legitimate third-party references for SPORTENVO without fake profiles, paid-link packages or invented project claims.

## Priority 1 — Client / Venue Supplier Credit

### PADEL.CNX — Chiang Mai, Thailand

Official venue: https://www.padelcnx.com/
SPORTENVO case study: https://sportenvo.com/project-chiang-mai-thailand-covered-padel-club.html

Goal:
- Ask the venue to add a short supplier / project-credit line on its About, News or venue-development page.
- Only publish the relationship if PADEL.CNX confirms the wording is accurate.
- Preferred link target: the SPORTENVO Chiang Mai case study or https://sportenvo.com/

Suggested short credit:
"Commercial padel court system and project support: SPORTENVO — https://sportenvo.com/"

Safer expanded credit:
"PADEL.CNX worked with SPORTENVO on the commercial padel court system and related project support for the Chiang Mai venue. Project reference: https://sportenvo.com/project-chiang-mai-thailand-covered-padel-club.html"

Email / message draft:
Subject: PADEL.CNX project reference / supplier credit

Hi PADEL.CNX team,

We have prepared a project reference for the Chiang Mai venue on the SPORTENVO website:
https://sportenvo.com/project-chiang-mai-thailand-covered-padel-club.html

To keep the public record accurate, could you please confirm whether you are comfortable with a short supplier / project-credit reference to SPORTENVO on your website or project/news page?

Suggested wording:
"Commercial padel court system and project support: SPORTENVO — https://sportenvo.com/"

If you prefer different wording, we can use the exact wording you approve. We do not want to overstate the project scope.

Thank you.

## Priority 2 — Sports Venue Business

Verified editorial contact (2026-09-29):
- Katie McIntyre: katie@sportsvenuebusiness.com
- General editorial: info@sportsvenuebusiness.com
- Source: https://sportsvenuebusiness.com/contact/

Best pitch angle:
"How a four-court covered padel venue in Chiang Mai was planned around tropical rain, heat, humidity and year-round operation"

Do not pitch as a generic product advertisement.

Subject:
Project story: four-court covered padel venue in Chiang Mai, Thailand

Pitch:
Hi Katie,

I’m sharing a commercial padel venue project reference that may fit Sports Venue Business’ project-development coverage.

PADEL.CNX in Chiang Mai operates four panoramic padel courts in a covered venue designed for year-round play in a hot, humid and rain-prone climate.

The useful project angle is not the product itself, but how the venue brief affects:
- court / roof clearances
- tropical weather protection
- lighting for evening operation
- installation interfaces
- venue circulation and commercial operation

SPORTENVO has documented the project here:
https://sportenvo.com/project-chiang-mai-thailand-covered-padel-club.html

The venue itself can also be independently verified through its official website and public booking platforms.

If useful, we can provide project photography and a concise technical summary for editorial review.

Best regards,
SPORTENVO
https://sportenvo.com/

## Rules

- Never buy bulk backlinks.
- Never ask a client to publish a supplier relationship they do not approve.
- Never ask media to reproduce unverified certifications, wind ratings or legal-company claims.
- Prefer one accurate project citation from a real venue over dozens of low-quality directory links.
- Use official SPORTENVO product names exactly.
- Link to the most relevant project / technical page, not always the homepage.
- Track every outreach attempt and resulting public URL.
